subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: Should OpenClaw keep replaying same-route Google text-part signatures, and if so what bound or storage strategy should prevent Gemini session bloat?
rationale: Current code and tests treat those signatures as replay-relevant provider state, while the issue shows that retaining large valid signatures can inflate sessions and contribute to lost replies; automation should not choose that provider contract alone.

options.title: Bound signature replay
options.body: Keep Google replay compatibility but cap, prune, detach, or externalize text-part signatures so session replay stays bounded.

options.title: Stop text-signature replay
options.body: Strip same-route text-part signatures after live Gemini multi-turn and tool-call proof shows they are not required.

options.title: Keep current replay
options.body: Document current signature retention as an intentional Gemini tradeoff and route affected users to provider or workload workarounds.

recommendation.title: Bound signature replay
recommendation.body: Keep Google replay compatibility but cap, prune, detach, or externalize text-part signatures so session replay stays bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Google provider replay and reasoning-mode lines route most directly through this contributor's recent merged work.
